Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for ACME's in-product assistant (low-latency, multi-tenant serving across regions).
- Key requirements you mentioned: 100 req/s peak, P95 latency < 200ms for standard prompts, private VPC option for regulated data, and SSO + audit logs.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Run a short technical deep-dive + demo (SE-led) to cover architecture, perf profile, and integration options
2) Share an initial MAP (mutual action plan) and decks
3) Kick off security questionnaire if you want to move to procurement

For the demo/tech deep-dive: can you confirm who from your side should join? I suggest including your Engineering Manager and a Product Owner. Here are two slots that work for our SE team:
- Wed, Oct 14 — 11:00am–12:00pm PT
- Thu, Oct 15 — 11:00am–12:30pm PT (we can extend to 90m for a deeper runthrough)

If neither works, tell me a couple of times that do and we’ll align. Once you confirm the slot and attendees I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom link and a short agenda. I’ve attached our intro deck and a proposed MAP draft for reference.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

Marissa here (SE) — happy to lead the deep-dive on Thu 10/15. Confirming we can do 11:00am–12:30pm PT and will plan for a 90-minute session. Proposed agenda:

- 11:00–11:10 — Introductions & goals
- 11:10–11:40 — Architecture overview & deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private VPC)
- 11:40–12:10 — Performance & cost controls (batching, KV cache, quantization) + short perf numbers for common prompt shapes
- 12:10–12:25 — Integration patterns & what we need for a quick spike

For a quick spike we'd ask for:
- A representative prompt set (10–20 samples)
- Expected concurrency/peak pattern (samples per minute)
- Any restricted data rules (PII / regulated data) so we can advise on Private/VPC requirements

I’ll prepare a short slide with the spike checklist and share it prior to the call. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
